control.name: CONTROL — drop the installer's .tar.gz spelling (the #4842 defect, restated as a mutation)

mutations.name: drop the suffixless per-platform spelling (older pin files lose their provenance)
let the .tar.gz line WIN over a suffixless line that is present (an existing consumer's verdict changes under it)
skip the platformLinePattern screen (a non-platform token such as `source` selects another component's line)
let the bare lookup come LAST (a platform line decides although the bare line is present)
drop the trailing space from the pin selector (`desk-tools ` matches every platform line, `.tar.gz` lines match by prefix)
